summary.name: ReadAny
summary.one_liner: ReadAny is an open-source, AI-powered desktop e-book reader with chat about books, semantic search, annotations, and note management.
use_cases: chatting with a book to ask questions and get summaries
annotating e-books and exporting notes to Obsidian or Notion
syncing library and highlights across devices
analyzing academic papers with AI and semantic search
summary.what_it_does: ReadAny is a desktop e-book reader that lets users chat with their books using AI, with support for OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Ollama, and DeepSeek. It offers five-color highlights, Markdown notes, and export to Obsidian, Notion, or plain Markdown. Text-to-speech uses Edge TTS with 100+ voices and background playback. It includes reading statistics such as heatmaps and streak tracking, and syncs libraries and notes via WebDAV, S3, or LAN with background sync. The page states the source code is open source and free, while app store versions may have a small fee.
notable: Chat with books using multiple AI providers including Ollama for local models
Highlights in 5 colors with Markdown notes exportable to Obsidian and Notion
Sync via WebDAV, S3, or LAN
caveats: App store versions may have a small fee; source code can be built for free
macOS may report the app as damaged; the page suggests removing the quarantine attribute with a terminal command
